trigger: Compact state activates but composed2-lane cold stalls before root. The allocation-summed PCS future remains dominant.

findings.finding: The cost calculator explicitly sums every rounded allocation request. This is an upper envelope, not simultaneous live memory.
Rolling PCS retires its combined DEEP arena, both sample scratch buffers and specified challenge/metadata planes after DEEP combine.
FRI full columns and trees are retired after openings and before the late source-rebuild scratch is allocated. Those reservations are disjoint in the current execution.
retirePlanes validates whole active temporary reservations, joins both lanes, marks them idle, then applies the configured idle-cache cap. Source planes and domains are excluded.

Zero idle-cache cap releases every retired block. Nonzero or disabled caps cannot support a simple max-of-phases contract without charging retained blocks. VMM mapped-free physical pages remain a separate accounting issue.
FRI storage is allocated before DEEP execution; it overlaps the DEEP arena already. Merely changing the summed cost into a phase maximum does not remove that actual coexistence.

Composition allocates its commitment LDE scratch before finish consumes quotient buckets. The buckets, accumulator and inverse lease remain in the common cleanup list through commitment. Moving real last-use retirement before LDE/tree allocation is a separate footprint opportunity.

obligations_before_any_discount: Enumerate each allocation with its exact word count, allocator rounding, birth phase, last-use join and retention policy. Validate coverage against actual native allocations, including borrowed source leases and cold domains.
Use the existing strict sorted borrow checks; count coefficient copies unless the physical lease roster proves a borrow. Include inherited idle caches or require a checked zero-cap contract.
Keep original summed path as default. A selected phase bound must fail closed if native capability or frozen allocation policy differs.
Report measured owner-attributed live peaks separately from process physical residency and mapped-free cache pages. Existing process/session high-water logs are not per-node peak proof.
Prefer deferring FRI allocations and retiring composition buckets/accumulator at actual last use over adding admission coordination. A model correction alone is not a physical footprint improvement.
Fused INTER numerator removal can lower its generation peak, but the current summed PCS future can remain dominant. Do not predict a complete admission fix from the numerator saving alone.
next_validation: A host-only real-class allocation census, then a source-bound physical lifetime change with byte parity. No new budget or permit machinery in this audit.
